\[
I_{\text{out}} = 255 \left( \frac{I}{255} \right)^{\gamma},
\qquad
\gamma = 0.6
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(I\): Input value from 0 to 255
- \(I_{\text{out}}\): Output value before rounding
- \(\gamma\): The exponent

The value is scaled to the range 0 to 1, raised to the power gamma and scaled back. 0 and 255 map to themselves. Gamma below 1 lifts every value in between, gamma above 1 lowers it. This is the power law used by Gonzalez and Woods and by skimage.exposure.adjust_gamma.
